FROM AMERICAN EXPRESS,
NOT FROM FLYING PLANES

scenes.vo: That's about ten percent of the airline's entire revenue, from one credit card deal.

visual.sub:
OF DELTA'S TOTAL REVENUE,

scenes.vo: Delta has now admitted it picks new flight routes partly to sign up more cardholders.

visual.sub:
CHOSEN PARTLY TO SIGN UP

scenes.vo: Its own CEO explained the strategy behind cities like Austin and Raleigh.

visual.quote: “…these are places we acquire a lot of cards.”

scenes.vo: Spending on Delta's card is now nearing one percent of the whole American economy.
Next year, Delta expects nine billion dollars from the deal, up ten percent from this year.
Sometimes the real business isn't the ticket. It's the card.
